methodology.operation: One read with the same business input and echo result. Native protocol envelopes are retained.
methodology.topology: Client and server in one Node.js process; real HTTP over loopback. No TLS, WAN, physical effects, persistent storage, or production authentication.
methodology.official_mcp_server: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.32.2; official documented stateless pattern: new McpServer and StreamableHTTPServerTransport per request, createMcpExpressApp, sessionIdGenerator undefined
methodology.raw_baseline: Minimal node:http JSON handler and global fetch; no validation, discovery, approval, or receipt. A lower-bound baseline, not an equivalent safety implementation.
methodology.repetitions: 3 rotated rounds × 100 measured calls per case after 10 warmups per round. Concurrency: 50 in flight. Cold starts: 30 child processes after 5 warmups.
methodology.fairness: One local read path only. Not a general protocol ranking or proof of quote/commit, WAN, or other-runtime performance.
